tasks.label: OpenOCD: Flash/Debug (Selected MCU)
tasks.command: if ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'dap \(Ozone\)') { Start-Process cmd -ArgumentList '/c start ${workspaceFolder}/Debug/gbd_start_dap_${input:mcuSuffix}.bat'; if (Get-Command Ozone -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process Ozone -ArgumentList '${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-${input:mcuSuffix}.jdebug' } else { Write-Error 'Ozone executable not found in PATH. Please add your Ozone installation directory to your system PATH environment variable.' } } elseif ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'jlink \(Ozone\)') { if (Get-Command Ozone -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process Ozone -ArgumentList '${workspaceFolder}/Debug/ozone/control-2026-${input:mcuSuffix}.jdebug' } else { Write-Error 'Ozone executable not found in PATH. Please add your Ozone installation directory to your system PATH environment variable.' } } elseif ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'dap \(Flash\)') { openocd -f Debug/config/openocd_dap_${input:mcuSuffix}.cfg -c 'program cmake-build-debug/control-2026.elf verify reset exit' } elseif ('${input:debuggerAction}' -match 'jlink \(Flash\)') { openocd -f Debug/config/openocd_jlink_${input:mcuSuffix}.cfg -c 'program cmake-build-debug/control-2026.elf verify reset exit' }
